goals.0: wenn clauses (condition): Wenn es regnet, bleiben wir
goals.1: When the wenn clause comes first, the verb comes first in the main clause
goals.3: Plans and possibility: vielleicht, hoffentlich, bestimmt
dialog.1.de.0.n: wenn clause: verb at the end
dialog.1.de.5.n: When the wenn clause comes first, the main clause starts with the verb: …, gehen wir
grammar.0.title: wenn clause: when it comes first, the verb comes first in the main clause
grammar.0.text: wenn starts a subordinate clause, with the verb at the end. When the subordinate clause comes first, the main clause begins with the verb (the whole subordinate clause counts as the first element).
grammar.1.title: Futur I: werden + infinitive (at the end)
grammar.1.note: In speech the future is often just the Präsens + a time word: „Morgen fahren wir nach Hamburg“. werden is used for predictions, promises and guesses.
grammar.2.title: Words of probability
grammar.2.note: The verb stays in second place after these: „Vielleicht fahren wir nach Berlin“; when an adverb comes first, the subject follows.
quiz.4.why: When the wenn clause comes first, the verb follows.
quiz.8.options.0: at the end of the sentence
quiz.8.prompt: Where does the infinitive go in Futur I?
quiz.8.why: werden is in second place, the infinitive at the end.
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “If it rains, we'll go to the museum.”
